package.name: rover_description
package.description: Module 2 of the Caterpillar Autonomy Challenge stack: the rover model. Xacro macros build a 4-wheel skid-steer excavation rover (gz diff-drive) with computed inertias, a ladder pitch joint, a belt roller joint, a tub and a funnel, an IMU without a magnetometer, wheel odometry and four plain RGB cameras (cam_nav, cam_tag, cam_excavation, cam_dump). Provides the one camera calibration YAML (intrinsics + extrinsics), the ros_gz_bridge table for image + camera_info, a mass budget table, an envelope-assertion script and the /estop + /battery/energy_wh interface stubs.
